structured.feedback: The description is about 200 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. It hedges the claims with "designed to" and "results vary", and it leaves out weaknesses, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the unsupported "easy to apply" claim, and the "fat-burning" wording taken from the listing.
